description_expanded: Overview4 FREE bikes and beach chairs, Community Pools, Tennis- Public Beach Access 2 Minute Bike RideThe SpaceQUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 4 FREE Bikes – Explore 30A with ease Two Community Pools – Heated Nov-Jan 1st, March 15th-May 15th Tennis & Basketball Courts – Stay active during your stay Playground – Perfect for families with kids Three Large Screened Porches – Relax & unwind outdoors Driveway - 4 Cars – Convenient parking Professionally Managed – 24/7 Guest SupportFREE set of beach chairs - seasonally two chairs one umbrella March - OctoberWelcome to Sunny's PlaceWelcome to “Sunny’s Place” where your vacation destination is a newly remodeled (late 2017), refurnished 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom one story home. Only a 6-minute walk to the white sugar sand beach and all of the fun and beauty that 30A has to offer.There are two master suites, each with private bathroom. We selected color palettes and fixtures suitable for our own family home. There is a shared “wet room” between the other two bedrooms. The wet room is a large spacious bathroom perfect for younger and older members of your family.One of the bedrooms has a special queen bed with an overhead twin constructed especially for our home by two local master carpenters. Both of these bedrooms have access to a side porch.There are two living areas separated by a fun barn door. Each of these areas are furnished with a new modern T.V. for everyone’s enjoyment. The dining area is perfect for pizza night. Get together around the table for a few moments of family chat.For the family cooks, the modern kitchen has a lovely environment that we thought mimics the colors of the Gulf. Our family loves to cook together so we outfitted the kitchen with top-of-the-line cookware and appliances. We didn’t forget the wine cooler with low shelves for drinks for younger family members. The Keurig coffee maker is a must.Outside you will find three screened porches, perfect for snoozing and story-telling. The back yard features a gas grill for preparing the day’s catch, even if you caught it at Publix.A little about us.... Our adult son selected the name “Sunny’s Place”. Sunny was our much-loved Labrador Retriever. She loved her stays in the “Grove”. She sat on the porch as we all grew older, girl friends, majors, college transfers, were all discussed on the front porch with our old girl listening lovingly. Her heart is truly at “Sunny’s Place”.The Grove by the Sea has two community pools, a tennis court, basketball goal and a playground.Come stay with us and see for yourself why Sunny's Place is one of the best houses in the Grove by the Sea.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**TV is streaming services only.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (8):Master bedroom: King sized bed, private en suite bathroom2nd Master Bedroom - King sized bed, private en suite bathroomGuest bedroom - Queen sized bed, shared bathroomBunk Room - Queen sized bed with twin sized overhead bunk, shared bathroomAREA ATTRACTIONS:Discover the charm of Seagrove, a beach neighborhood that locals and guests love. Lush oak trees, magnolias, and pines have spread deep roots in Seagrove — and so have long-time visitors who keep coming back.Laid-back but luxurious, Seagrove is a place that embraces variety. From upscale boutiques to casual cafes, this beach neighborhood offers a little bit of everything — including two rare coastal dune lakes, a state park, and sugar-white sand. Pack a picnic, fishing pole, and binoculars — and witness how stunning Seagrove is in its all-natural state. Its sugar-white sand has been a peaceful retreat in South Walton for decades; here, old and new Gulf Coast style merge to create a charming beach neighborhood with everything one may need for a truly relaxing getaway.Show less
